'''Mike Smith''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2000 Cedar Grove tournament]] on 29 January 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down (Bad Feeling Have I)]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base / Our Most Desperate Hour]], according to Michael Dalton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d210">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-30-1-29-00-cedar-grove-njd210/ 1-29-00-cedar-grove-nj], DeckTech (Michael "faramir" Dalton, 30 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-30-1-29-00-cedar-grove-njd210/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
